_doc: Campaign shell (M5): one region strip — nodes unlock in order, each is an encounter from enemies.json; winning holds the node, granting income per real-world day (timestamp-computed) and notoriety. Notoriety crossing threatGen2At announces Threat Generation 2 and unlocks nodes gated with 'threatGen': 2. rescueEncounter = the themed battle used for every rescue raid (v0.1 has one template). Adding regions/nodes must never require engine edits.
